mode: llama.cpp b11938, CPU only (-ngl 0) to approximate a laptop without a graphics card
method: worker_gguf.py driven directly with self-written public short samples; one run each. Returned text is execution evidence, not a quality judgement.

samples.ja>en: It's sunny today. I'm going to the park with my family.
samples.en>ja: 今日は晴れている。家族と一緒に公園に行く。
samples.fr>en: It's sunny today. I'm going to the park with my family.
samples.auto>ja: 図書館は毎週月曜日は休館です。
samples.ja>en with glossary 図書館=community librar: The community library in front of the station is closed on Mondays.

samples.ja>en: It's sunny today. I'm going to the park with my family.
samples.en>ja: 今日は晴れだ。家族で公園に行く。
samples.fr>en: It's nice weather today. I'm going to the park with my family.
samples.auto>ja: 図書館は毎週月曜日は休館です。
samples.ja>en with glossary 図書館=community librar: The community library in front of the station is closed on Mondays.

limits: Mac CPU speed is not Windows laptop speed. Windows has not been tested. No long documents, no 8B/31B GGUF.
